description: Read-only. One page of trees with cursor pagination, the same data as GET /api/forest?limit=. Pass nextCursor as cursor until it is null.

bbox.description: Bounding box [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] in world coordinates. Only trees inside it are returned.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from nextCursor of the previous page.
